premise: Crab can't wait to see what Clam keeps inside her shell; Urchin tells him some things take a long time, and Clam opens to show a pearl that grew for years.
inspiration: The guarded-treasure folk motif (the box that must not be opened too soon), turned into patience: the treasure is something that grew slowly.
lesson: The best things can take a long time.
learning: A pearl grows very slowly inside a shell, layer by layer.

en-US.title: The Clam's Secret
en-US.text: {clam:enter} Clam lived at the bottom of the rock pool, {clam:face happy} and she had a secret. {crab:enter} Crab {crab:go to clam} scuttled over. {crab:face happy} [curious] What's inside your shell, Clam? Something special, said Clam. But you have to wait. {crab:shake} Crab waited. One second. Two seconds. {crab:face sad} [playfully] Is it ready YET? {urchin:enter} Urchin rolled over, slowly. [warmly] Some things take a long, long time, Crab. Like growing. {urchin:pulse} [short pause] At last, {clam:live hold} Clam opened up wide. {crab:face surprised} [gasps] There, inside, was a little round pearl, softly shining. {clam:glow 0.6} It started as a tiny speck, said Clam. And very slowly, layer by layer, it grew. For years and years. {crab:live} Crab clicked his claws and danced. {urchin:hearts} [softly] And for once, Crab didn't say a word. He just looked, for a long, long time.

es-ES.title: El secreto de Almeja
es-ES.text: {clam:enter} Almeja vivía en el fondo de la charca, {clam:face happy} y tenía un secreto. {crab:enter} Cangrejo {crab:go to clam} se acercó correteando. {crab:face happy} [curious] ¿Qué guardas en tu concha, Almeja? Algo especial, dijo Almeja. Pero tienes que esperar. {crab:shake} Cangrejo esperó. Un segundo. Dos segundos. {crab:face sad} [playfully] ¿YA está? {urchin:enter} Erizo se dio la vuelta, despacito. [warmly] Algunas cosas tardan mucho, mucho tiempo, Cangrejo. Como crecer. {urchin:pulse} [short pause] Por fin, {clam:live hold} Almeja se abrió de par en par. {crab:face surprised} [gasps] Allí dentro había una perla pequeña y redonda, brillando suavecito. {clam:glow 0.6} Empezó siendo una motita, dijo Almeja. Y muy despacio, capa a capa, fue creciendo. Durante años y años. {crab:live} Cangrejo chocó las pinzas y bailó. {urchin:hearts} [softly] Y por una vez, Cangrejo no dijo ni una palabra. Solo miró, durante mucho, mucho rato.
